description: This file defines an enumeration 'LoanProductValueConditionType' representing different types of value conditions for loan products, such as invalid, equal, and greater than. It includes methods to retrieve the integer code and string code for each type, convert from integer to enum, and check the specific type.

classes.name: LoanProductValueConditionType
classes.description: An enum representing different condition types for loan product values, with methods to facilitate conversions and checks.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with the condition type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the condition type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding 'LoanProductValueConditionType' enum value, defaulting to INVALID for unrecognized values.

methods.name: isValueConditionTypeEqual
methods.description: Checks if this condition type is 'EQUAL'.

methods.name: isValueConditionTypeGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this condition type is 'GREATERTHAN'.
